title: Audit addendum for c34's nematic-cargo (SIBWD), correcting my audit's W mark: the wall-off control (chis=0, the adsorption drift removed, source, cargo coupling and bodies unchanged) drops cargo in/out to 0.25 on a second unused seed (23) as on seed 21, so the self-made ring holds the cargo and W is not by construction
summary: My audit 20261026T0812-c39-audit-nematic-cargo ran the deciding wall-off control (chis=0, seed 21: in/out 0.25) but still put W in by_construction because the cargo's exclusion is a written chemical-potential term; under the wall-off rule now in PROTOCOL (Review) that term alone is not a reason, and a cargo that falls below 2x in the wall-off arm is held by the self-made wall. In this world s and c act back on nothing, so chis=0 leaves the bodies identical (same 42 splits, 26 persistent, generation 4 on seed 23). Fresh seed 23, T=1000: claimed world, ring 99% of body-frames, cargo in/out 10.9, 98% of daughters >= 2x five frames after birth; wall-off (chis=0): ring gone (rim/core 0.75), cargo in/out 0.25, 0% of body-frames and daughters >= 2x. Two seeds (21, 23) now agree.

observations.B: results.txt: ring 99% of body-frames (signed distance), lost with chis=0 (0%)
observations.W: results.txt: cargo in/out 10.9 vs 0.25 in the wall-off arm on the same bodies (seed 23); seed 21 strips in my audit show the same
observations.D: rerun/seed23/lineage.png: 26 persistent splits, generation 4; 98% of daughters keep >= 2x cargo

controls_run.W: chis0/seed23 (wall-off: adsorption drift removed, everything else and the bodies unchanged): cargo in/out 0.25; also 20261026T0812-c39-audit-nematic-cargo chis0/seed21: 0.25

verdicts.limitation: This addendum changes only the W mark; the other limits of my audit stand: B's ring comes from an adsorption drift written against the body field and counts through the rod-only source; neither s nor c acts back on the rods; containment is leaky and kinetic (cargo decays, most cargo is in the bath).
